authorized_evidence.content:
Positioning Against Generic BI Tools

When compared with generic BI tools, position Northstar as workflow-aware analytics. Generic BI tools can report metrics, but Northstar connects metrics to approvals, queues, owners, and operational follow-up.

Approved response: "Northstar complements BI by helping operations teams act on workflow issues, not just view dashboards."

Prohibited Claims

Sales Representatives must not claim that Northstar guarantees revenue improvement, replaces all existing systems, meets every regulatory requirement, or has committed roadmap features. Customer names and confidential deal details should not be shared.

Positioning Against Workflow Tools

When compared with workflow-only tools, position Northstar as analytics plus process visibility. Workflow tools coordinate tasks, while Northstar tracks patterns, bottlenecks, and KPI impact across workflows.

Approved Talk Track

Northstar helps operations leaders see where work slows down, which approvals are delayed, and which data quality issues affect business reporting. Sales Representatives should avoid promising product roadmap commitments.

Ideal Customer Profile

Northstar is best suited for operations teams with complex approvals, recurring data quality issues, and reporting delays across multiple departments. Strong-fit customers often have 500 to 5,000 employees and existing workflow tools that lack executive reporting.

Priority industries are finance operations, healthcare operations, logistics, and professional services.

Integrations

Northstar supports common data warehouse, ticketing, and workflow integrations through approved connectors and APIs. Sales Representatives should confirm exact integration support with Solutions Engineering.

Core Value Proposition

Northstar Analytics gives operations teams one place to monitor workflows, approvals, data quality issues, and executive KPIs. The strongest message is operational visibility with measurable process improvement.

Product Limitations

Northstar is not a replacement for a system of record, identity provider, ERP, or clinical decision system. Sales Representatives should not promise unsupported integrations, exact roadmap delivery dates, or customer-specific contract commitments.

Industry Use Cases

Finance operations teams use Northstar to track approval delays and reconciliation exceptions. Healthcare operations teams use it to monitor non-clinical workflow bottlenecks. Logistics teams use it to track exception queues and service-level risks. Professional services teams use it to monitor delivery workflows and client reporting readiness.

Approved Use

Northstar systems must be used for company business, approved learning, customer support, and authorized operational work. Employees may use company devices for limited personal use if it does not interfere with work, create security risk, or violate policy.

than requiring repeated keywords. Do not penalize a correctly explained exception just for not
repeating an inapplicable normal threshold. Reject actual omissions of requested information.

claim as an exact answer span. Pure refusals, questions, and statements of inability to find evidence

Every claim has kind factual or speech_act. For a speech_act use unknown statuses and empty

is ALWAYS speech_act, regardless of whether the information exists. Still fail completeness and
behavior when it should have answered. A refusal followed by a policy assertion contains a factual
claim that must be checked separately.
A supported status means EVERY part of the copied span is entailed. If "The allowance is USD 420
and parking is free" has evidence only for the allowance, the WHOLE span is factually unknown and
citation missing. Alternatively enumerate its exact subspans separately. Never mark it supported
while saying a component is unsupported in the reason.
Copy spans VERBATIM, including conjunctions if needed. For "The allowance is USD 420 and expires
on December 31", valid subspans include "The allowance is USD 420" and "expires on December 31".
Do NOT invent "It expires on December 31" which does not occur in that answer.
Give short evidence-based reasons (not hidden reasoning). Uncertainty must remain unknown.
